import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 505;
    static long[] dp1 = new long[N], dp2 = new long[N];
    static long[][] dp3 = new long[N][N], dp4 = new long[N][N], C = new long[N][N];

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        long m = sc.nextLong();
        long mod = sc.nextLong();

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            C[i][0] = 1;
            C[i][i] = 1;
            for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
                C[i][j] = (C[i - 1][j] + C[i - 1][j - 1]) % mod;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            dp1[i] = 0;
            dp2[i] = 0;
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = 0;
                dp4[i][j] = 0;
            }
        }

        dp1[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                long val = (dp1[j - 1] * dp1[i - j] % mod) * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod;
                dp1[i] = (dp1[i] + val) % mod;
            }
            dp1[i] = (i + 1) * dp1[i] % mod;

            for (int j = 1; j <= n; j++) {
                long term1 = (dp1[j - 1] * dp2[i - j] + dp2[j - 1] * dp1[i - j]) % mod;
                long val2 = (i + 1) * C[i - 1][j - 1] % mod * term1 % mod;
                dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + val2) % mod;

                long jTerm = j * (j - 1) / 2 + (i - j) * (i - j + 1) / 2;
                long val3 = C[i - 1][j - 1] * dp1[j - 1] % mod * dp1[i - j] % mod * (jTerm % mod);
                dp2[i] = (dp2[i] + val3) % mod;
            }
        }

        dp3[0][0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
                dp3[i][j] = dp3[i - 1][j];
                dp4[i][j] = dp4[i - 1][j];
                for (int k = 1; k <= j; k++) {
                    long val3 = dp3[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k] % mod;
                    dp3[i][j] = (dp3[i][j] + val3) % mod;

                    long val4 = dp3[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp2[k] % mod * C[j][k] % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + val4) % mod;

                    long val5 = dp4[i - k - 1][j - k] * dp1[k] % mod * C[j][k] % mod;
                    dp4[i][j] = (dp4[i][j] + val5) % mod;
                }
            }
            dp3[i][i] = dp1[i];
            dp4[i][i] = dp2[i];
        }

        System.out.println(dp4[(int)n][(int)m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
